title: Symbiodinium cp23S RFLP and Sequence Analysis
author: Pringle Lab
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qyjdxun
materials: Example 25 µl PCR setup using Promega GoTaq® 2× master mix: Thermocycler setup: GoTaq Green Master Mix Promega Catalog #M7122

steps.title: Amplify cp23S locus by PCR
steps.instruction: Amplify the cp23S locus using 25 µl reactions with primers 23S4F and 23S7R. Include a negative control reaction without template.

substeps.instruction: Use primer 23S4F (forward): 5’-GAC GGC TGT AAC TAT AAC GG-3’
Use primer 23S7R (reverse): 5’-CCA TCG TAT TGA ACC CAG C-3’

steps.title: Verify PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Check for successful amplification of fragments (roughly 500-600 bp) using agarose gel electrophoresis.

substeps.instruction: Mix 3 µl of PCR reaction with 2 µl water and 1 µl 6× DNA loading dye
Run on a 1% agarose TAE gel in TAE buffer
Use a standard DNA ladder (e.g., GeneRuler DNA Ladder Mix Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #SM0331)

steps.title: Purify PCR products
steps.instruction: Purify the remaining PCR volumes using a PCR purification kit according to the manufacturer's instructions.

substeps.instruction: Elute in 30-50 µl elution buffer (10 mM Tris, pH 8.5) or water

steps.title: Set up Hph I restriction digest
steps.instruction: Prepare 30 µl restriction enzyme reactions for RFLP analysis.

steps.title: Incubate restriction digest
steps.instruction: Incubate the reactions at 37°C using one of the following two options:

substeps.instruction: Option 2: Digest with 0.3 µl HphI overnight (≥8 h) at 37°C

steps.title: Analyze RFLP results
steps.instruction: Run the digests on a high-concentration agarose gel to achieve good separation (at least 5 cm run length).

substeps.instruction: Mix 10 µl of the digests with 2 µl 6× DNA loading dye
Run on a 3% agarose gel using Borax gels and buffer (or TBE)
Load a low range DNA ladder (e.g., GeneRuler 50 bp DNA Ladder Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #SM0371)

steps.title: Sequence purified PCR products
steps.instruction: Sequence the purified PCR products using primers 23S4F and 23S7F following the service provider's instructions.

substeps.instruction: If mixed strains are expected, subclone PCR fragments into plasmids and sequence multiple clones per sample to avoid uninterpretable Sanger sequencing results
